text: CalendarDialogRow attaches an open shadow root, clones calendarDialogRowTemplate and exposes icon, label and content slots. Current assignedElements tests compare each actual assigned element with its light-DOM slot attribute. Preserve that shadow slot boundary when composing sibling rows; appending similar light-DOM markup alone does not create the same slot contract. This is source/identity-test evidence, not a live rendered result. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The generic Calendar row exposes three named shadow slots
